officialTitle: Efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant pertuzumab and trastuzumab in women with locally advanced, inflammatory, or early HER2-positive breast cancer (NeoSphere)

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Of 417 eligible patients, 107 were randomly assigned to group A, 107 to group B, 107 to group C, and 96 to group D.
primaryEndpoints: Pathological complete response in the breast
design.notes: Four arms (1:1:1:1), four neoadjuvant cycles. After surgery, FEC and trastuzumab to complete 1 year. Survival endpoints descriptive only.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding pertuzumab to trastuzumab and docetaxel increase the pathological complete response rate in neoadjuvant treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer?

pico.population: Treatment-naive women with operable, locally advanced or inflammatory HER2-positive breast cancer
pico.intervention: Pertuzumab + trastuzumab + docetaxel (group B); also pertuzumab + trastuzumab without chemotherapy (C) and pertuzumab + docetaxel (D)
pico.outcomes: Primary: breast pCR. Secondary: 5-year PFS, DFS, safety

arms.label: Group B: pertuzumab + trastuzumab + docetaxel
arms.regimen: Pertuzumab, trastuzumab and docetaxel x4 cycles
arms.dosing: Pertuzumab 840 mg loading then 420 mg q3w; trastuzumab 8 mg/kg loading then 6 mg/kg q3w; docetaxel 75 mg/m2 (escalating to 100 mg/m2 if tolerated) q3w
arms.doseSourceQuote: trastuzumab (8 mg/kg loading dose, followed by 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks) plus docetaxel (75 mg/m(2), escalating, if tolerated, to 100 mg/m(2) every 3 weeks; group A) or pertuzumab (loading dose 840 mg, followed by 420 mg every 3 weeks) and trastuzumab plus docetaxel (group B)

arms.label: Group A: trastuzumab + docetaxel
arms.dosing: Trastuzumab 8 mg/kg loading then 6 mg/kg q3w; docetaxel 75 mg/m2 (escalating to 100 mg/m2 if tolerated) q3w
arms.doseSourceQuote: trastuzumab (8 mg/kg loading dose, followed by 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks) plus docetaxel (75 mg/m(2), escalating, if tolerated, to 100 mg/m(2) every 3 weeks; group A) or pertuzumab (loading dose 840 mg, followed by 420 mg every 3 weeks) and trastuzumab plus docetaxel (group B)

arms.label: Group C: pertuzumab + trastuzumab
arms.regimen: Pertuzumab and trastuzumab without chemotherapy x4 cycles

publications.title: Efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant pertuzumab and trastuzumab in women with locally advanced, inflammatory, or early HER2-positive breast cancer (NeoSphere): a randomised multicentre, open-label, phase 2 trial.
publications.label: Primary pCR analysis

publications.title: 5-year analysis of neoadjuvant pertuzumab and trastuzumab in patients with locally advanced, inflammatory, or early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer (NeoSphere): a multicentre, open-label, phase 2 randomised trial.
publications.label: 5-year analysis

outcomes.endpointLabel: Pathological complete response in the breast
outcomes.population: ITT, group B vs group A
outcomes.sourceQuote: Patients given pertuzumab and trastuzumab plus docetaxel (group B) had a significantly improved pathological complete response rate (49 of 107 patients; 45·8% [95% CI 36·1-55·7]) compared with those given trastuzumab plus docetaxel (group A; 31 of 107; 29·0% [20·6-38·5]; p=0·0141).

outcomes.endpointLabel: Pathological complete response in the breast
outcomes.sourceQuote: 23 of 96 (24·0% [15·8-33·7]) women given pertuzumab plus docetaxel (group D) had a pathological complete response, as did 18 of 107 (16·8% [10·3-25·3]) given pertuzumab and trastuzumab (group C).

outcomes.population: ITT, group B vs group A
outcomes.sourceQuote: 5-year progression-free survival rates were 81% (95% CI 71-87) for group A, 86% (77-91) for group B, 73% (64-81) for group C, and 73% (63-81) for group D (hazard ratios 0·69 [95% CI 0·34-1·40] group B vs group A, 1·25 [0·68-2·30] group C vs group A, and 2·05 [1·07-3·93] group D vs group B).

outcomes.population: Patients who had surgery, group B vs group A
outcomes.sourceQuote: Disease-free survival results were consistent with progression-free survival results and were 81% (95% CI 72-88) for group A, 84% (72-91) for group B, 80% (70-86) for group C, and 75% (64-83) for group D.

outcomes.population: All groups combined: total pCR vs no total pCR
outcomes.sourceQuote: Patients who achieved total pathological complete response (all groups combined) had longer progression-free survival compared with patients who did not (85% [76-91] in patients who achieved total pathological response vs 76% [71-81] in patients who did not achieve total pathological response; hazard ratio 0·54 [95% CI 0·29-1·00]).

safety.description: Grade 3 or higher neutropenia (group B vs group A)
safety.sourceQuote: The most common adverse events of grade 3 or higher were neutropenia (61 of 107 women in group A, 48 of 107 in group B, one of 108 in group C, and 52 of 94 in group D)

strengths: Randomised four-arm design isolating contributions of pertuzumab, trastuzumab and chemotherapy
limitations: Primary endpoint is a surrogate (breast pCR)
Survival analyses not powered and descriptive only

clinicalImplications.text: Supported neoadjuvant dual HER2 blockade with pertuzumab and trastuzumab plus a taxane to increase pathological complete response in HER2-positive breast cancer.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Group C showed that dual HER2 blockade alone eradicated tumours in a minority of patients — a signal that informs de-escalation research, not a standard.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from PubMed abstracts of PMIDs 22153890 and 27179402 (decimal middle-dots retained in quotes).
